name: Orbital Solitude
letterform_rule: thin capitals; 0.23em tracking; tiny leading article
scene_rule: edge-lit planet; lone figure; vast black atmosphere
motion_rule: letters fade in from distant horizon; 6s
visual_anchor: A silver planetary rim arcs over a tiny figure; widely tracked narrow capitals sit against blue-grey atmospheric depth.

name: Marble Dynasty
letterform_rule: wide-spaced medium contrast Roman capitals; one cracked diagonal
scene_rule: worn stone sculpture bisecting frame
motion_rule: fracture light progressively illuminates capitals; 7s
visual_anchor: A worn stone face fills the right half; widely spaced antique-gold serif capitals cross the dark left field.

name: Forest Signal
letterform_rule: tall steel capitals; a single accent stem; no direct logo copying
scene_rule: symmetrical conifer forest reflected in foggy lake
motion_rule: accent line drops then reflection emerges; 5s
visual_anchor: A pine forest and lake reflection frame tall pale capitals; one isolated red stem interrupts the vertical rhythm.

name: Crimson Fabric
letterform_rule: elegant ultra-thin hairlines; generous optical spacing
scene_rule: red folded fabric forms sculptural shadows
motion_rule: light crawls along fabric then settles; 6s
visual_anchor: Large pale high-contrast serif capitals span folds of burgundy velvet, with a small spaced article above.

name: Confinement Wall
letterform_rule: heavy narrow all-caps; damaged edges; slight counter tension
scene_rule: aged concrete; scratched tally lines outside the title
motion_rule: word revealed by harsh moving strip light; 5s
visual_anchor: Black distressed condensed letters sit tight against a pale scarred wall; tally strokes surround the title.

name: Sunset Signature
letterform_rule: fast hand-drawn strokes with asymmetric rise; readable descenders
scene_rule: sunset boulevard silhouettes; layered skyline
motion_rule: single continuous handwriting reveal; 5s
visual_anchor: An upward-slanting peach signature spans a dusky coral skyline; dark palms frame the edges.

name: Alpine Inscription
letterform_rule: low contrast inscription capitals; one custom north marker separate from letters
scene_rule: snow mountain horizon; tiny climber
motion_rule: sunrise light rakes across letters; 7s
visual_anchor: Bright classical capitals cross a cold alpine ridge; a small compass-like glint balances the baseline.

name: Submerged Whisper
letterform_rule: thin wide-tracked capitals partially veiled by water
scene_rule: dark underwater looking upward; soft caustics
motion_rule: letters slowly disappear behind refraction; 8s
visual_anchor: Spaced, very fine capitals hang below a bright rippled water surface in deep teal darkness.

name: Wildflower Memory
letterform_rule: humanist serif with quiet weight contrast; small cursive article
scene_rule: dusk wildflower meadow; imperfect sunlight
motion_rule: soft dissolve from moving grasses; 6s
visual_anchor: A small handwritten introductory word sits over open serif capitals; flowers catch warm backlight below.

name: Siege Ledger
letterform_rule: bold industrial all caps; authentic ink erosion, not random grunge
scene_rule: smoke-filled damaged city silhouettes
motion_rule: darkened city emerges as light moves horizontally; 7s
visual_anchor: Dark worn block capitals rise above a solitary figure in a grey ruined streetscape.

name: Solar Interval
letterform_rule: ultra-spaced thin geometric capitals across the center of a dark solar disk
scene_rule: centered dark solar disk with a narrow luminous golden corona strongest along the top rim
motion_rule: eclipse moves 3 degrees; letters hold still; 8s
visual_anchor: Ultra-spaced geometric capitals straddle a dark solar disk; a fine golden corona carries the light.

name: Electric Corner
letterform_rule: two-tone script word + clean secondary condensed sans
scene_rule: rainy roadside diner neon sign; reflections
motion_rule: neon warms up irregularly, no strobe; 5s
visual_anchor: Two slanting lines of blue and rose neon script glow beside a night diner; the wet street catches both colors.

name: Regal Silence
letterform_rule: soft classical serif with extreme optical spacing; restrained gold
scene_rule: candlelit hallway; imperial architecture without copied insignia
motion_rule: candle flutter only; title slowly resolves; 6s
visual_anchor: Warm gold classical capitals sit in the darkness between paired architectural lights; keep the article small.

name: Analog Apparition
letterform_rule: novel thick-thin serif with imperfect offset; avoid double-line red iconic TV wordmark
scene_rule: night forest and anonymous distant horizon, irregular CRT glow
motion_rule: tension builds via tiny horizontal scan bars; 6s
visual_anchor: Red outlined serif lettering sits in two compact lines over a blue-black treeline; devise independent lettering and framing.

name: Industrial Afterlight
letterform_rule: wide block industrial capitals with purpose-built notches; original silhouette
scene_rule: abandoned industrial square at dust sunrise
motion_rule: moving dust exposes each letter; 5s
visual_anchor: Slanted dense industrial capitals carry fine abrasion; place the dark title against a dusty ochre sky.

name: Organic Survival
letterform_rule: rough grounded compact capitals; no famous stacked-letter arrangement
scene_rule: overgrown train tunnel with tiny figure
motion_rule: fern shadows cross unmoving letters; 7s
visual_anchor: Tight, stacked worn ivory capitals occupy a passage between overgrown urban ruins.

name: Event Horizon
letterform_rule: mathematical wide tracking; one absent stroke to imply unknown
scene_rule: gravitational light bent across deep space
motion_rule: silent expanding ring behind locked title; 8s
visual_anchor: Thin geometric caps sit on two open lines beside a blue planetary limb; keep most of the field black.

name: Resort Irony
letterform_rule: formal literary serif, polished hierarchy against uneasy tropical setting
scene_rule: quiet symmetrical resort pool with unnatural stillness
motion_rule: water moves while title remains rigid; 7s
visual_anchor: Dark editorial serif capitals sit in warm resort light, centered between palms and architecture.

name: Clinical Mind
letterform_rule: condensed utilitarian capitals with deliberate optical gaps
scene_rule: out-of-focus observation room and desk light
motion_rule: rack focus to lettering; 4s
visual_anchor: Alternating narrow letter widths form a cold pale wordmark across a grainy monochrome face.

name: Security Corridor
letterform_rule: tightly spaced tall grotesk; small security metadata away from letters
scene_rule: empty government corridor, overhead cold bars
motion_rule: flicker of one offscreen light only; 6s
visual_anchor: Compact pale block capitals sit against dark civic architecture with sparse horizontal signal artifacts.

name: Personal Mark
letterform_rule: decisive angled strokes and inconsistent caps, hand-shaped not font tracing
scene_rule: windswept waves and handheld photographic crop
motion_rule: one clean draw-on line; 4s
visual_anchor: A large dry-brush signature crosses sea spray; preserve broken ink edges and a forward gesture.

name: Inherited Secret
letterform_rule: wide-tracked contemporary capitals, quiet hierarchy
scene_rule: night horizon between ocean and black shore
motion_rule: subtle red rim reveals title from dark; 8s
visual_anchor: Widely tracked upright capitals float above a dark waterline broken by a single red reflection.

name: Checkmate Study
letterform_rule: modern high contrast literary serif, no pawn glyph in letters
scene_rule: abstract chessboard perspective with one plain piece
motion_rule: single sliding side-light in 5s
visual_anchor: Balanced fine serif capitals sit above a single chess piece; low perspective draws the board toward the title.

name: Arc-Lit Metropolis
letterform_rule: ornamental engraved Roman capitals with new glyph rhythm
scene_rule: independently designed towering art-deco fantasy city
motion_rule: individual street lights sequence on, then type; 7s
visual_anchor: Warm metallic letter edges contrast with a cold blue layered city silhouette; design original glyphs.

name: Signal Parallax
letterform_rule: technical thin geometric lettering; non-repeating scan gaps
scene_rule: reflective dark profile silhouette and subtle digital interference
motion_rule: brief phased parallax distortion on edge only; 5s
visual_anchor: Fine spaced capitals and a few horizontal signal breaks cross an offset cool-toned profile.

name: Feral Diary
letterform_rule: original irregular dry hand lettering; not the show’s signature word shape
scene_rule: unquiet dense forest with loose cloth in branch
motion_rule: tree shadows drift slowly; 7s
visual_anchor: A fast, irregular yellow handwritten stroke cuts across a dark forest; invent a distinct hand and flourish.

name: Desert Monument
letterform_rule: thin wide-set geometric capitals with original open strokes and a smaller tracked second line
scene_rule: low dunes in deep shadow; a giant copper-lit planetary limb enters from the right
motion_rule: slow giant shadow moves across valley; 9s
visual_anchor: Center a wide single line of slender champagne-bronze geometric capitals with original open strokes. Place the smaller tracked second line below, low dunes along the bottom and a huge copper planetary limb entering from the right. Keep the sky dark and the title dominant.

name: Underworld Block
letterform_rule: huge tight vertical display, dark red on black; not the existing TV lockup
scene_rule: anonymous high-rise brick alley under red street light
motion_rule: shallow camera push-in, no logo animation copy; 6s
visual_anchor: Dense, heavy vermilion capitals fill a tight block against an almost black alley.

name: Ritual Ember
letterform_rule: glowing thin-hairline capitals with controlled carved gold metal texture
scene_rule: newly designed ritual chamber, elliptical ember projection, candles
motion_rule: thin halo grows then stops; smoke only afterward; 7s
visual_anchor: Scale engraved copper-gold serif capitals above a low candlelit table; a dim red arc lights the space behind the title.

name: Evidence Wave
letterform_rule: heavy stepped condensed capitals; waveform is distinct horizontal scene layer
scene_rule: recording room, case notes, analog audio recorder
motion_rule: wave line enters after title and passes behind it; 6s
visual_anchor: Stack heavy condensed type in a cold green recording room; let a fine waveform cross the composition.

name: Wet Mirror
letterform_rule: wide cold serif capitals split by independently placed glass crack
scene_rule: rain on window, anonymous shadow, deep city reflections
motion_rule: one raindrop follows crack and distorts reflection; 7s
visual_anchor: Split two lines of thin silver serif lettering with a diagonal fracture on rainy glass; silhouettes remain behind the pane.

name: Coastal Ruin
letterform_rule: weathered classical capitals with natural edge abrasion
scene_rule: stormy ocean, ruined coastal stonework, dark gulls
motion_rule: sea spray flickers under rigid title, long hold; 8s
visual_anchor: Spread weathered bronze serif capitals across a coastal sky, with low dark surf and a side-lit cliff.
